# RawThoughts

> Software, research and consulting that follow one question: how a person, a model, an organisation or a society with limited knowledge and resources forms a workable picture of reality, acts through it, learns from what follows and keeps agency and accountability as scale and capability grow.



## Start here

- [Engineering without filters](https://rawthoughts.in/index.md) ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/))

- [Make work flow across teams and systems](https://rawthoughts.in/services/index.md): Improve one business workflow through a paid audit, an agreed build and support where needed, with product judgement and hands-on engineering. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/services/))

- [Products](https://rawthoughts.in/products/index.md): Together the products form one system a person runs, with people deciding, and each part except Scope, which brings context from Pale, Weave or both, can also be used alone. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/products/))

- [Thoughts](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/index.md): Each collection follows one question into what decides whether a capability becomes useful work: reaching people, the work AI capacity completes, responsibility in everyday practice and the design behind the products. Single arguments are on the Blog. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/))

- [Blog](https://rawthoughts.in/blog/index.md): Independent arguments about workflows, useful compute, evaluation and the work around a capability. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/blog/))

- [About RawThoughts](https://rawthoughts.in/about/index.md): An applied engineering practice where ideas, systems and operating work inform one another. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/about/))


## Projects and products

- [Counsel](https://rawthoughts.in/counsel/index.md): Local judgment where rules leave a choice, with a separate model service to help Scope find useful context. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/counsel/))

- [Gazette](https://rawthoughts.in/gazette/index.md): Maintain one article and let readers reach it on its own, in a collection or in a product guide. Gazette builds connected publications from the writing and sources you choose. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/gazette/))

- [Pale](https://rawthoughts.in/pale/index.md): See which review instructions apply in a repository and what would change before you install them. Pale compiles those instructions and permissions from one workspace. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/pale/))

- [RawFish](https://rawthoughts.in/rawfish/index.md): Try a creator, workplace or civic decision in a simulated setting before anyone decides, then investigate what the reactions suggest. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/rawfish/))

- [Scope](https://rawthoughts.in/scope/index.md): The smallest fresh account of a task, with its sources, decisions, people and open questions intact. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/scope/))

- [Weave](https://rawthoughts.in/weave/index.md): Weave’s design keeps a customer’s failed export linked to its investigation, review and the check that it works again. The same records carry customer relationships and work. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/weave/))


## Collections

- [Ideas](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/ideas/index.md): What lets a promising capability become useful work, and where its value reaches people. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/ideas/))

- [Practice](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/practice/index.md): Following responsibility, uncertain outcomes and acceptance through everyday work. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/practice/))

- [Systems](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/index.md): Together the products form one system a person runs, with people deciding, and these journeys take up its parts. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/))

- [Useful compute](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/useful-compute/index.md): Follow AI capacity from the infrastructure promise to the work it can actually complete. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/useful-compute/))


## Reading journeys

- [Testing India's AI crossing](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/ideas/india-ai/testing-indias-ai-crossing/index.md): Move from the national opportunity to what the infrastructure must deliver, who holds the claim on its value and what survives a disruption. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/ideas/india-ai/testing-indias-ai-crossing/))

- [Context that helps the work](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/context-that-helps-the-work/index.md): Choose the context a task may use, notice when its premises change, and learn which information helps the work. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/context-that-helps-the-work/))

- [Learning from a recommendation](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/learning-from-a-recommendation/index.md): How evidence changes advice, and how a decision and its outcome can help improve later judgment. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/learning-from-a-recommendation/))

- [Making a working world intelligible](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/making-a-working-world-intelligible/index.md): From recovering the meaning of a task to comparing the structure that could help carry it. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/systems/making-a-working-world-intelligible/))
